scenarios.reasoning: The agent efficiently diagnosed the build failure, correctly identified the root cause (LrgWindowsAppManifest not in the solution causing configuration issues), and provided a reasonable fix. However, it fell short on actually listing the projects in the solution — providing only a count rather than names — which was a core part of the question. The configuration analysis was solid but slightly speculative in places. The investigation path was methodical and recovered well from the initial file-not-found errors.
